Append JavaScript to an Existing htmlwidgets Render Hook

append_onRender.Rd

Appends JavaScript code to an existing htmlwidgets render hook, allowing multiple widget customisations to be applied via successive calls. This is useful when composing functions that each add their own onRender() behaviour without overwriting previously registered JavaScript.

Usage

append_onRender(p, js_code)

Arguments

p

An htmlwidget object.

js_code

A character string containing JavaScript code to be executed when the widget is rendered. The code should be a valid onRender() callback function.

Value

The modified htmlwidget object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p <- networkD3::sankeyNetwork(...)

p <- append_onRender(
  p,
  "function(el) { console.log('First hook'); }"
)

p <- append_onRender(
  p,
  "function(el) { console.log('Second hook'); }"
)
} # }
